# Session 3 - The Silt Accord

## Down to Tallow Quay

Two days of poling through flat water. Wren spent most of it reading the one page of the
log book that survived.

## The Company's Offer

[[The Ambergris Company]] wanted the marsh route surveyed and was willing to pay for it,
provided nobody asked what the survey was for.

## Ferrant's Warning

[[Ferrant Oake]] caught Petra alone on the quay and told her the accord had been signed
once already, a long time ago, and that it had not held.

## The Long Marsh at Night

The first night in [[The Long Marsh]] cost the crew a lantern and most of its nerve.

## Session Summary

### Major Events

- The crew took the survey contract from [[The Ambergris Company]].
- [[Ferrant Oake]] revealed that the Silt Accord is older than the Company claims.
- The Company's charts stop at [[Halvern Reach]], which nobody has written up.

### Loot & Rewards

- 40 marks each, paid in advance.
- [[The Tideglass Lens]], lent rather than given.

### Character Moments

- Wren refused to sign, and signed anyway.

### Open Threads

- What the Company wants surveyed.
- Whether the first accord was broken or simply forgotten.
